subject: Request: headroom allocation for POC throughput validation
messages:
From: Julie Park <julie.park@fastretail.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: POC: temporary headroom for throughput soak test

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency consistency. We have a 72-hour soak window coming up (starting next Tue) to validate sustained throughput and KV cache behavior. To run realistic traffic we need a short-term increase in trial allowance / credits so our SREs can ramp to ~3k concurrent requests (token mix ~40% short, 60% long) for the duration.

Questions:
- Can Redwood provision a temporary credit top-up or a promo allocation just for the POC window?
- Any constraints we should know about for autoscaling during the soak?

I attached a brief test plan. If possible we'd like a quick yes/no so we can finalize the test schedule.

Thanks,
Julie Park
Senior Platform Engineer, FastRetail
sre-team@fastretail.com

Attachment: poc-load-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 92KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: julie.park@fastretail.com
Date: 2027-05-20T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: POC: temporary headroom for throughput soak test

Internal — looping you in. FastRetail is requesting a short-lived credit bump for a 72-hour throughput soak starting Tue. Key facts:
- Target concurrency: ~3,000 concurrent requests (expected peak token throughput ~4M tokens/hour)
- Duration: 72 hours continuous ramp/sustain
- Purpose: validate autoscaling, KV cache hit stability, and tail latency under sustained load
- They provided a test plan (attached).

Can Sales + Ops approve a promo allocation or one-off credit top-up? If we need a formal SLO exception for burst capacity, Karthik — can you advise process and estimated approval time? Ben — finance sign-off on a promo grant (no invoicing) would be ideal. If we can move quickly we can lock the test date.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124

On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 09:12 AM Julie Park <julie.park@fastretail.com> wrote:
> Hi Stephanie,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency consistency...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, julie.park@fastretail.com
Date: 2027-05-20T13:25:00Z
Subject: Re: POC: temporary headroom for throughput soak test

Stephanie — OK to approve a one-off promo allocation for this POC. Recommendation:
- Grant a time-limited credit bundle equivalent to $6,000 worth of tokens, valid for 7 days, with explicit usage monitoring.
- Tag the allocation to deal DL-FASTR-2027-05 and expire automatically at the window end.

Karthik — please raise the SLO exception ticket (I attached the suggested justification). Marissa — please confirm we'll not auto-bill; this is a promotional grant tied to the POC.

I attached a short SLO exception doc and the suggested promo wording.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: slo-exception-request.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 24KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, julie.park@fastretail.com
Date: 2027-05-21T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: POC: temporary headroom for throughput soak test

Looping in infra / capacity team. I've created internal ticket INF-8742 to request a temporary quota increase and SLO exception for the specified window. Notes from infra:
- We can provision the requested headroom if we reserve a pre-emptible node pool for the 72-hour window.
- Need exact start/end timestamps to schedule the reservation.
- Ops requests the exact expected token rate and concurrency ramp schedule (they referenced your plan).

Stephanie — once you confirm dates we'll provision and update the ticket. Keeping Julie on copy so they can confirm schedule.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Julie Park <julie.park@fastretail.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-22T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: POC: temporary headroom for throughput soak test — schedule confirmation

Thanks everyone — confirming the schedule:
- Start: 2027-05-25T02:00:00Z
- End: 2027-05-28T02:00:00Z
- Ramp: linear over 6 hours to 3k concurrent, hold for 62 hours, ramp down 4 hours
- Expected peak: ~4M tokens/hour, 3k concurrent

We appreciate the promo allocation. Please let us know the allocated credit token amount and whether there are any API rate-limit exceptions we should be aware of. We'll share test telemetry to the Drive folder.

Julie Park
Senior Platform Engineer, FastRetail
